title: Isolated agent verification of packaged tooling
summary: Fresh agent sessions exercise packaged MCP registration and integrity without inheriting ordinary development-session context.

dates.note: Exact start/end dates are not documented. Technical mechanisms are reported in the October 5, 2026 snapshot; any later owner clarifications are cited per fact.

facts.text: Built isolated agent-verification sessions with blank workspaces and session-local Codex state, excluding normal MCP registrations, skills, hooks, history and guidance.
Implemented verification checks for exact packaged registration, provider configuration, module integrity, health/proof output, an MCP handshake and absence of remaining runtime-owner records.
The subsystem provides host-native development and packaged-agent rehearsal; cluster publication and acceptance belong to a separate workflow.

notes: The supplied analysis inspected verification implementation without executing it. Do not convert implementation checks into an unrecorded live run, repeated benchmark or pass percentage.
